ideas.idea: Add a concrete integrations list or supporting links for the 'Integrates with all the tools' claim
ideas.why: The home page makes a vague claim in app/routes/_index.tsx that gives readers and machines nothing specific to understand.

ideas.idea: Add a visible contact or sales link on pricing for 'Talk to us for a quote'
ideas.why: The pricing page tells visitors to talk to the team but offers no link or way to do it.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD for site identity
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it goes against that.

ideas.idea: Explicitly add charset, viewport and social-sharing metadata to the head
ideas.why: This applies to almost any site and the report only says to 'confirm or add' it.

ideas.idea: Add related-content links on features and changelog pages
ideas.why: The advice is vague, and it does not name the pages to link to.
